name: thoth
description: Private N-of-M attestation for Midnight — a TypeScript monorepo.

scripts.pretest: npm run compact && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/core && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.types: npm run build --workspace=packages/core && npm run build --workspace=packages/attestor && npm run build --workspace=packages/client && npm run build --workspace=packages/zk-tls && tsc --noEmit && npm run types --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run check:biome && npm run check:compact
scripts.check:fix: npm run check:fix:biome && npm run check:fix:compact
scripts.check:ci: npm run check:biome && npm run check:compact
